item.title: Heat Risk Calculator: Exact Heat Values Per Action and Safe Windows
item.description:
Quick answer: Selling drugs in view of a cop = Low heat (Investigating level). Assaulting an NPC = Medium heat. Pulling out a weapon = High heat (Wanted level). Hitting a cop = Maximum heat (Wanted Dead or Alive instantly). Each action has a fixed heat value the game uses to decide police response.

This guide is a reference tool -- not an explainer. Bookmark it. Use it before every sale.

item.title: Police AI Behavior: Detection Distances, Chase Durations, and Best Hiding Spots
item.description:
Short answer: Police in Schedule I use line-of-sight (LOS) detection with a 15m base range. Detection is blocked by walls, vehicles, and terrain. Chase duration scales with heat level: 30s at Level 1, 60s at Level 2, 90s at Level 3, 3min+ at Level 4. Entering a safe house clears all heat instantly. The parking garage roof near the motel is the only 100% safe spot at all heat levels as of v0.4.5.

This breakdown shows you exactly how cops think, so you can exploit their AI patterns instead of running blindly.
